title: Genomic pilot workflow and selected genome manifest for a preregistered study of prophages and anti-phage defence systems in West African Escherichia coli
description:
Workflow, genome selection and registered protocol for the calibration pilot of a comparative genomics study of prophages, prophage-encoded virulence determinants and anti-phage defence systems in West African Escherichia coli.

This deposit is the GitHub repository archived at the tagged release. It accompanies the preregistration at 10.17605/OSF.IO/FXMEQ, which fixes the study design, the eligibility rule and the analysis decision rules. That registration carries no file attachments, so the artefacts it describes are deposited here. Section 12.0 of the protocol records SHA-256 checksums for them, so the deposit can be verified against the registered design.

Contents. The Snakemake workflow, in Snakefile with scripts/ and envs/, runs geNomad, an independent prophage predictor, CheckV at both a 10 kb and a 5 kb flank, DefenseFinder, CRISPRCasFinder, Bakta, CheckM2, seqkit and PopPUNK at parameters fixed in the protocol, resolving to 1,356 jobs across the 96 pilot genomes. config/pilot_manifest.tsv lists those 96 genomes with block, stratum, originating study, ecological source, country and quality band, and config/samples.tsv is the sheet the workflow consumes. resources/ holds the retrieval metadata and the NCBI Datasets assembly statistics. tests/test_chain.py drives the prediction to boundary-refinement chain against a synthetic genome with proviruses at known coordinates and asserts the coordinates that emerge. docs/ carries the registered protocol and the manuscript availability statement.

Ordering. The v1.0.0 deposit was made after the registration and before the pilot was run. No prophage had been predicted, no defence system called and no genome sequence downloaded at that time.

Licensing. Software under MIT. Selection tables and retrieval metadata under CC0, since they derive from ENA and NCBI records already in the public domain. See LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA.
